build_penguins_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for the Palmer Penguins dataset with processed, simple, and raw configurations
create_penguin_config: create a PenguinConfig builder config specifying file name, features, label, and cleanup rules for a dataset split
test_builder_info: test the Builder._info method to return dataset metadata with FeaturesDict and supervised keys
run_generate_examples: run the Builder._generate_examples method to yield row-based examples from a CSV file path
review_clean_up: review the Builder._clean_up method to handle NaN replacement for floats and OOV replacement for class labels
